name: Complexity Check
description: Warns if cyclomatic complexity of functions exceeds a configurable threshold after file edits, encouraging simpler code
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check cyclomatic complexity after file changes
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
THRESHOLD=${CLAUDE_COMPLEXITY_THRESHOLD:-10}
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    OUTPUT=$(cd "$ROOT" && npx eslint --rule "complexity: [warn, $THRESHOLD]" --no-eslintrc "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep complexity | head -5)
    if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then
      echo "High complexity detected in $FILE (threshold: $THRESHOLD):"
      echo "$OUTPUT"
      echo "Consider breaking complex functions into smaller ones."
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
